verse.text: Children are a gift from the Lord; they are a reward from him. Children born to a young man are like arrows in a warrior's hands.

video.title: D.I.N.K.s and the Gift of Children - Psalm 127

reflection: Every kid at your table—whether toddling or towering over you now—is on loan from God, not a burden to manage but an arrow to aim. That means your job isn't just feeding and correcting; it's prayerfully pointing them toward a purpose bigger than your own house. So tonight, instead of just asking about homework, ask God what target He's shaping in your child, and let that shape how you speak to them tomorrow.
